channel.title: Forkline
channel.description: Forkline covers Ethereum and crypto news with clear reporting on protocol upgrades, markets, networks, and the people building on-chain finance.

item.title: Congestion Turns Crypto Transfers Into a Routing Market
item.description: When blockspace gets scarce, crypto transfers reroute through cheaper chains, bridges, and liquidity pools, shifting cost, delay, and risk to the sender.

item.title: AMMs Route Across Chains, but Bridges Set the Risk
item.description: AMMs make cross-chain swaps possible by pricing local liquidity, but bridges and solvers still decide whether the asset arrives safely and who absorbs the risk.
